1) **Your email address** (so I can locate your user profile), and  
2) The **order id** (looks like `#W0000000`), and  
3) Confirm which item in the order is the **tablet** (if there’s more than one tablet, tell me which one by name/size/color shown on your order).

Once I have that, I’ll look up the item prices for the **E-Reader + everything else (except the tablet)** and tell you the **exact refund amount** and where it will be credited.
